page.layout: One printed page. Top: page number and running head across the top. Then a division number "LXXI" centred, then a title in italic display type, then body text in roman/bold-italic paragraph with a drop-cap initial. No margin notes.

main_text.head: LXXI.

Mandata à nobis HenricoDei Gratiâ Rege Navarreno, Principe Bearniæ, &c. Domino Jacobo Segurio Pardiliano domui nostræ Præfecto & Interioris nostri Consilii primo Consiliario tradita, ex quorum formula cum Illustrissimis Sacri Romani Imperii Electoribus, reliquisque Germaniæ Principibus, qui Religionem Reformatam profitentur, nostro nomine acturus est.
main_text.p: EUndem Illustrissimum Principem nostris verbis officiosissime salutabit, benevolentiam erga ipsum nostram, eximium amorem & observantiam testabitur, desiderinmque illud

page.notes: The drop-cap "E" is joined to "Undem" as "EUndem". Line "desiderinmque" is printed so; "illud" is the last line of the page. Some words in the display title are heavily worn; "Mandata" and "Dei" read with confidence, the rest as printed.
